scope: Bead cr-talb, plan 56: audit 2026-10-22 items #1, #7, #8, #15 and the show-me pointer

subject: ours:tdd
why: Overlap audit #1 (test retention): tdd's writing-good-tests.md now owns the rule, keep a test that catches a distinct failure and remove one only when its behaviour is covered elsewhere or intentionally retired, inspecting a changed test rather than deleting it; codebase-design, review and to-plan point here. Gains covered-test-removal from codebase-design.

subject: ours:codebase-design
why: Overlap audit #1: DEEPENING.md no longer restates the test-retention rule; it keeps, changes or removes old tests by tdd's retention rule. covered-test-removal moves to tdd; internal-seams and dependency-categories stay.

subject: ours:to-plan
why: Overlap audit #1 (test seams): plan-format's Test seams field is chosen by tdd's seam rule instead of restating it. No trait change.

subject: ours:review
why: Overlap audit #1: the code review judges tests by tdd's criteria in writing-good-tests.md instead of restating them. No trait change; test-quality-judgment still holds.

subject: ours:discovery
why: Overlap audit #8 (inline diagrams) and #7 (HTML contract): discovery keeps when to draw during design and reads show-me's forms and rules for how, so it no longer defaults to Mermaid; its on-request HTML file follows html-artifact's artifact contract. Drops inline-diagrams (its definition, Mermaid-specific, stays true of that mechanism) and gains structure-question-visual.

subject: ours:prototype
why: Overlap audit #7: a shared logic prototype's HTML file follows html-artifact's artifact contract instead of restating offline rules. No trait change.

subject: ours:show-me
why: The show-me pointer: escalation to html-artifact now names its actual trigger (explicitly requested, or a standalone visual materially helps; a report alone is not one). No trait change; html-handoff holds.

subject: ours:brief-me
why: Overlap audit (failure loop): the debug-spiral override now takes its stop from the work's owner (the running playbook's stop, or the parent's limit) instead of counting three turns; with no playbook it routes through mvp-mode to bug-fix. No trait change; debug-spiral-reset holds, distinct from two-failure-stop.
